goodsServices.description: Cast building materials; casings for buildings; chimney caps, cowls, tops and pots; girders; railway sleepers; all made from common metal.
Earthenware junction boxes (electric cable); laboratory crucibles and cupels (fire clay); retorts (earthenware).
Bathtubs, water closets basins and pedestals, taps, lavatory basins, furnace fittings and blocks, hearths, lamp and stove burners, all made from china, porcelain, stoneware, earthenware or fire clay.
